readerCopy.body: One precise question reaches the record everyone else was willing to leave closed. Mercury sextile Pluto can turn a discrepancy in a budget, contract, timeline, or access log into enough leverage to request the missing document. This is where specificity matters. Do not argue with the official summary if one detail can test it. Ask for the source behind the claim, follow the first refusal, and keep the request narrow enough that an evasive answer becomes obvious.
